brandTone: Modern, direkt, nahbar, locker, duzen. Familienunternehmen aus Köln, ehrlich und bodenständig, ohne Marketing Floskeln. Klar, freundlich, selbstbewusst, glaubwürdig, nicht steril medizinisch.
brandStory: True Nature ist ein Familienunternehmen aus Köln, gegründet 2019 von Lukas und Samuel Peto. Wir bauen hochwirksame Rezepturen aus natürlichen Inhaltsstoffen, kombiniert mit moderner Wissenschaft und strengen Qualitätsstandards. Made in Germany, unabhängig geprüft, große Dosen zum fairen Preis.

manualCI.notes: Use True Nature’s own corporate identity: deep green #003e2a, warm cream #f8f7f0, pale green #d9fab3. Original packaging and logo stay unchanged. Style references affect composition, image dominance and hierarchy, not their brand colours or typography.

productCI.designerNotes: Use supplied original product photos. If a rendering is proposed, label it as a production task; never imply an existing rendering asset. Keep claims within the supplied brand facts.

designReferences.notes: Minimal photographic communication with short copy, generous negative space and deliberate category grouping. Apply this macro style in True Nature’s own corporate identity. Home is a brief category router; category pages solve product selection differently; the origin page stays editorial.

textOverlay.heading: Aus Köln. Aus Überzeugung.
textOverlay.body: Lukas und Samuel Peto haben True Nature 2019 gegründet. Heute sind wir ein Familienunternehmen für Nahrungsergänzung.

tiles.brief: Typographic origin panel beside the genuine founder photograph. Set one confident heading and a compact two-sentence body in the approved brand type system, deep green on cream. Use generous open space and a comfortable reading measure; no icon badges, faux signature or timeline. The photograph provides the personal detail, so this panel stays factual and brief. For mobile square, use fewer words per line and a clear heading-to-body hierarchy; preserve the full provided copy without tiny text.

Original close-up photographic concept showing genuine True Nature packaging and a restrained arrangement of neutral natural materials, with no ingredient pictured unless it is confirmed for the specific visible product. Place the short product-approach statement in a large cream area rather than making a technical infographic. This closes the story with the brand’s stated formulation approach, distinct from the founder facts above. Do not manufacture lab footage, certifications or test seals. Mobile is a separate square composition with the headline and one short line above the photographic detail.
